checks.note: Prompts and config are baked into the image from the repo and read from APP_ROOT/prompts. The manifest records their sha256, and app/startup.py compares them at startup. No code fetches prompts from a URL, database or flag.
The repo has no CODEOWNERS file and no review-rule IaC. Required reviews may be set in repository settings, which are not visible here.

The release job builds, signs and attests only on main. The image is tagged with the commit SHA and the digest is recorded. Kyverno enforces digest-pinned images signed by the main workflow. There is no deploy workflow in the repo, so who applies deployment.yaml and how it is recorded is outside the repo. The manifest says CI regenerates it, but CI only verifies hashes.
The repo has no branch protection or ruleset config. Force-push protection may be set in repository settings, which are not visible here.
